Game-owned package for the facilitated business game «Карты, деньги, поезда». It contains authoring/runtime manifests, bounded fixtures, delivery assets, the player-web board plugin, and root-level asset-provenance.json — a provenance registry (list of records, validated against the platform schema docs/architecture/schemas/asset-provenance.schema.json) covering both delivered assets and author source materials, with source hashes, conversion details, and publication-rights status per record.
